intro: Over the past three months, ZCyberNews has tracked 15 Kaspersky-related reports, with CrystalX, GoSerpent, and HelloNet emerging as the most frequently observed threat actors. The coverage, spanning from April 16 to July 30, 2026, documents 12 high-severity and one critical incident affecting finance, education, energy, government, and building automation sectors. These cases were reported across Global, Russia, Southeast Asia, Africa, and APAC regions, reflecting a broad operational footprint. The archive consolidates these findings, offering a chronological record of activity tied to this tag.
